property_summary: After creating one proposal via newAddressProposal (proposalCount becomes 2 in P, 3 in M), then creating another via newGrantProposal (proposalCount becomes 3 in P, 4 in M), then calling cancelProposal(oldProposalID=1, newProposalID=3), the reference P passes (does not revert) while the buggy M reverts because mapPID_type[3] is empty (since M skipped index 2), causing isEqual to revert via low-level call to sha256 on empty bytes.
change_summary: Replace increment proposalCount += 1 with proposalCount += 2 on new address proposal
